findings.detail: Uniguest delayed-draw debt was retained from the December 31, 2024 comparative schedule in a September 30, 2025 report-date holdings set.
Uniguest revolver debt was retained from the December 31, 2024 comparative schedule in a September 30, 2025 report-date holdings set.

rationale: PP03 is a row-level position-purity flag, so this was routed as Class 2. The filing table of contents labels the comparative schedule as December 31, 2024, and the flagged Uniguest delayed-draw and revolver rows appear in that comparative schedule at table 46 rows 29-30. Because the reviewed report_date is September 30, 2025, retaining those comparative-period rows in the report-date holdings set is a real data error.
